Engineered Wood Flooring

We supply and fit engineered wood floors in living rooms, hallways and bedrooms across Aberdeen and Aberdeenshire, starting with a proper check of the subfloor.

Call 07748 146181 WhatsApp Us

Real Hardwood, Stable Boards

Engineered wood flooring offers the natural beauty and warmth of real hardwood, combined with excellent stability and durability.

It is ideal for homeowners looking to upgrade their living rooms, hallways and bedrooms with a timeless, high-quality finish.

Signs you may need new flooring include worn surfaces, scratches, movement, outdated finishes or damaged boards.

How We Fit Engineered Wood

At Fairmont Flooring, every engineered wood installation begins with a thorough assessment of the existing subfloor to ensure it is clean, level, dry and suitable for installation.

We use carefully selected premium engineered hardwood products, quality underlays and manufacturer-approved adhesives and installation systems.

Where required, we carry out professional floor preparation, moisture testing and levelling before installation.

Our experienced fitters take care over every detail, including precise cutting, expansion allowances, doorways, thresholds, skirting and finishing trims.

We never compromise on preparation or materials, ensuring every floor is installed to a high professional standard and designed to provide lasting beauty and durability.

A Recent Job: Engineered Oak Flooring Installation

Aberdeen

Fairmont Flooring recently undertook an engineered wood flooring installation for a homeowner looking to transform their existing interior. The original flooring was dated and required upgrading to achieve a more modern, elegant appearance. We assessed the existing subfloor, completed the necessary preparation and installed premium engineered oak flooring, ensuring accurate alignment, neat perimeter detailing and professional finishing throughout. What Others Get Wrong

One of the biggest problems we see with engineered wood installations is inadequate subfloor preparation.

Some installers rush the process without thoroughly checking moisture levels, floor levels or the condition of the existing surface.

This can lead to movement, gaps, creaking and premature flooring problems.

At Fairmont Flooring, we believe preparation is just as important as the flooring itself.

We take the time to inspect, measure and prepare every surface correctly, use suitable manufacturer-approved installation systems and pay close attention to expansion allowances and finishing details.

We never cut corners to save time.

How Long It Takes and What It Costs

Most installations take approximately 1 to 3 days, depending on the room size and preparation required.

Supply and installation typically start from £85 to £125 per m², depending on the wood and specification.

Every quote is free and no-obligation, and follows an assessment of your project.

Your Questions

Is engineered wood flooring better than laminate?

Engineered wood features a real hardwood surface and offers a more natural premium appearance. Laminate is generally a more affordable and low-maintenance alternative.

Can you install flooring over underfloor heating?

Many engineered wood and LVT products are suitable for underfloor heating, provided the manufacturer's installation requirements and temperature restrictions are followed.
